Title: Catatonic Fear + Target Vitals or Disarm

Messages.Author: Robert Dudock
Messages.Body:
Can a Target card such as Target Vitals be used with Catatonic Fear?
Can Disarm? I was fairly certain thesee issues were answered long ago,
but I cannot find the posts on here.

Thanks,
Robba Yaga

CATATONIC FEAR
Combat
Presence
Blood Cost: 1
Card Text:

Inferior: Strike: combat ends.
Superior: As above, and inflict 1 damage to the opposing minion once
combat ends if the range is close.

Clarifications and Rulings
-The damage from Catatonic Fear is dealt by the striking vampire (so
would be reduced to zero by Memories of Mortality). [LSJ 19990723]
-The after-combat damage effect is lost if the end-combat effect is
lost (due to a Telepathic Tracking, for example). [LSJ 20001127]
-If combat continues (via Telepathic Tracking, for example), then
Catatonic Fear's damage will "linger" until combat actually ends, just
as the torporizing effect of Undead Persistence does. [RTR 20010710]

TARGET VITALS
Combat
Card Text:

Aim. Play when choosing a strike.

If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on the
opposing minion, he or she takes an additional 2 damage from this
strike, and he or she cannot press this round. The opposing minion may
discard two combat cards [COMBAT] to cancel this card. A minion may
play only one aim each strike.

DISARM
Combat
Potence
Card Text:

Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this vampire
successfully inflicted more damage at close range than the opposing
vampire; not usable by a vampire going into torpor. Put this card on
the opposing vampire and send that vampire into torpor. The vampire
with this card has -1 strength; he or she may burn this card by
burning 3 blood. A vampire can only have 1 Disarm

As above, but the vampire with this card has -2 strength.

A problematic link to post, because Blood Tears hasn't prevented damage
outside combat for quite a few years.

You can, however, prevent it with Leather Jacket (it's damage from a
strike) or Surge counters (the damage is still during the action).
